items.title: Israel and Lebanon agree to 10-day ceasefire, says Trump
items.description: The president said he "had excellent conversations" with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Lebanese President Joseph Aoun, and a ceasefire would begin 7am AEST.

items.title: Pope blasts 'tyrants' spending big on war following public spat with Trump
items.description: The US-born pope has praised peace movements and peace makers during his visit to the African nation of Cameroon as the rift with US President Donald Trump intensifies.

items.title: US alliance indispensable as Marles looks to build more self-sufficient ADF
items.description: Defence Minister Richard Marles has declared the United States alliance will remain indispensable for Australian national security even while Australia looks to build a more self-reliant defence force.

items.title: Bombs, rain and destruction: Life in Gaza six months into a ceasefire
items.description: Palestinians in Gaza fear they are being forgotten as the Iran war drags on, with Israeli strikes continuing despite a ceasefire and the humanitarian situation still dire.

items.title: 100m litres of diesel secured under new powers, PM confirms
items.description: Anthony Albanese says that new powers allowing the federal government to underwrite the delivery of additional fuel cargoes have been used to purchase 100 million litres of diesel.

items.title: Mandelson failed vetting but was given UK ambassador to US job anyway
items.description: Peter Mandelson was sacked from the role after revelations about his connections with the late sex offender became public.

items.title: Russia launches deadliest attack on Ukraine this year, killing 17
items.description: Russian forces have attacked the Ukrainian capital Kyiv and other cities, killing 17 people, as the defence leaders of more than 50 countries say they are aiming to send more aid to Ukraine.

items.title: Australian dollar surges to four-year high as traders see end to Iran war
items.description: Analysts say the mood on global financial markets has improved considerably over the past few days.

items.title: The cause of the Viva Energy oil refinery fire under investigation. Here's what we know
items.description: Firefighters have managed to extinguish a blaze at one of Australia's major oil refineries. Here's what we know so far about the cause of the fire — and the possible impact on fuel prices.

items.title: Prince Harry tells summit he's 'felt lost, betrayed, or completely powerless’
items.description: The Duke and Duchess of Sussex are back together in Melbourne after spending the second day of their Australian tour apart.

items.title: Hanson wishes Coalition good luck, government focuses on fuel
items.description: This week in Canberra, Pauline Hanson learned imitation is the sincerest form of flattery, the defence budget was on the agenda and a fire threw the fuel crisis into sharp relief.

items.title: Trbojevic injures hamstring as Manly thrash Cowboys
items.description: The Sea Eagles have smashed North Queensland but the win has come at a heavy cost following a hamstring injury to star fullback Tom Trbojevic.

items.title: Daicos inspires Magpies to win as Blues youngster misses kick after siren
items.description: Nick Daicos stars in the final quarter to inspire Collingwood to a win as Carlton youngster Talor Byrne misses a kick after the siren to tie the scores.

items.title: 'No-one's committed murder here': Port CEO urges change to tribunal process
items.description: Port Adelaide's chief executive has slammed the AFL Tribunal process, labelling it "too legalistic" and "too adversarial".

items.title: How to tell if your dog is in pain and what to do if they are
items.description: New research suggests that many dog owners are not skilled in recognising pain in their pets.

items.title: NSW premier told to resign after protest laws struck down by top court
items.description: The laws, rushed through parliament after the Bondi Beach terrorist attack, have been found to be unconstitutional by the state's highest court.

items.title: Prisoner accidentally released in 'embarrassing' bungle located
items.description: A man accidentally released from a northern NSW corrections centre has been found by police.

items.title: Report finds Darwin Harbour biodiversity rivals that of Ningaloo Reef
items.description: New research has revealed Darwin Harbour's biodiversity, including its wide range of rare species, rivals that of the World Heritage-protected Ningaloo Reef.

items.title: Businesses evacuated as fire contained in Brisbane's east
items.description: Emergency services were called to Hemmant just after 3pm, with more than a dozen crews attending the scene.

items.title: Rebel Wilson's The Deb is a delight despite the ongoing legal drama

items.title: Quiz: Can you tell the difference between The Pitt and ER?
items.description: Ahead of The Pitt season finale dropping this week, can you pick the difference between it and its hospital drama ancestor ER?

items.title: Is LIV Golf dead? Not yet, but the vultures are circling
items.description: Rumours of LIV Golf's immediate demise look wide of the mark, but the smoke is only growing thicker as denials from the league's CEO help paint a bleak picture.

items.title: New data reveals age group spending up big
items.description: Australians spent more in March as the outbreak of the Iran war drove up petrol prices. Older Australians increased their spending at the fastest pace, CBA data shows.

items.title: Farmers 'running on empty' welcome arrival of diesel
items.description: A massive crude oil tanker laden with diesel has docked in the Port of Newcastle to replenish regional New South Wales supplies, as the Middle East unrest continues.

items.title: Explosions heard during fire in Byron Bay bike shop
items.description: The northern NSW town was bustling with holiday-makers enjoying the Easter school holidays when the fire broke out in the CBD this afternoon.
